jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v1/companies/{company}/postings. Optional limit and offset page through results (response total = totalFound).

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single job via authenticated GET /jobs/{id}. Distinct from public jobs.list/postings.list.

postings.list.title: List postings
postings.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v1/companies/{company}/postings. Optional q, limit, offset, country, region, city, and department filters.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: Search candidates via authenticated GET /candidates. Optional limit, pageId, q, jobId, updatedAfter, and status filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via authenticated GET /candidates/{id}.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List company users via authenticated GET /user-api/v201804/users. Optional limit, pageId (cursor from nextPageId), q, and updatedAfter filters. offset is deprecated and ignored (the Users API pages by pageId).

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interviews for an application via authenticated GET /interviews-api/v201904/interviews. Requires applicationId.
